children: Medicus Pharma entered a Co-Development and License Agreement with Pfizer to advance CD228V, an early clinical-stage antibody-drug conjugate targeting CD228, worldwide. The deal provides Medicus an exclusive, sublicensable license to Pfizer’s patents for development, manufacturing, and commercialization, with Pfizer retaining ownership and receiving milestones exceeding $1.0 billion and low double-digit royalties. Medicus paid $12 million upfront and owes $15 million on the first anniversary, while Pfizer contributed a $2 million development funding payment and holds an option to fund development from the first pivotal trial. Medicus will control development and commercialization and may grant sublicenses.
: Co-Development and License Agreement for CD228V (antibody-drug conjugate)
: Advance global development and commercialization of CD228V
